issues.acceptance: Shared-controller telemetry safely handles player and NPC instances.
issues.actual: A broad runtime digest caused a debugger break: Invalid access to property or key 'dialogue_state' on StaticBody3D (hers_npc.gd). player_controller._mcp_state unconditionally reads get_parent().dialogue_state.mouse_sensitivity. This was observer-triggered; ordinary gameplay failure was not established. After restart, scoped player probes worked and the final callback's runtime log had no errors.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active foundation requires more than the inherited Snaiel components: training_monster.gd still supplies a hand-written enemy driver, while Ronen and Hers instantiate Player.tscn and disable its controls after initialization. The inspected prior views show Ronen sharing the player's silhouette. Adjacent integration defects are concrete: H is absent from the binding reservations but is consumed by preview_controller before Roll dispatch; combat notices use fixed bottom positioning alongside scaled ammunition and expose Q02; player telemetry unconditionally accesses its parent's dialogue_state. These findings support one complete actor-foundation increment with bounded input, feedback and observation repairs. Remaining HUD closeout cells are missing evidence, not established product failures.
